report.notes: The resolved policy is now bound in the event chain together with the config file hash. policy_sha256(cfg) = chash(policy(cfg)) is computed live on each run, so it includes the ws_frozen_check protected list re-read from the main checkout. PLAN, CONFIG_CHANGED and OWNER_UNBLOCK events record policy_sha256. config_binding() returns the bound pair (config_sha256, chash(recorded policy)) read from the chain only. run() records CONFIG_CHANGED and blocks with CONFIG if either hash differs; the block clears only after an OWNER_UNBLOCK with the same pair. A first version stored the hash at load time; it broke 15 existing tests that edit cfg in memory after loading, so the hash is computed live instead. New test test_r4_01_relaxed_ws_frozen_check_list_blocks_as_config_change fails on 43467152 (second run returns VERIFIED instead of BLOCKED) and passes after the fix. Full tests/dev_workflow suite: 142 passed. Updated the Policy binding row in docs/dev_workflow/URI_DEVELOPMENT_LIFECYCLE.md.
